# Check what changed on the 3rd RIGHT
before_seg = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation

def get_nodes(seg):
    result = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        bounds = (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b))
